.standard-page-layout {

  top: 120px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 140px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.toc-nav .sidebar-heading,

  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;

  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.toc-nav .sidebar-links,
.history-nav .sidebar-links {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.toc-nav .sidebar-links li,
.history-nav .sidebar-links li {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.toc-nav .sidebar-links a,
.history-nav .sidebar-links a {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-dark);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.toc-nav .sidebar-links a:hover,
.history-nav .sidebar-links a:hover {
  background-color: var(--light-blue);

}

.main-content-area {

    max-height: none;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const articlesHistoryList = document.getElementById('articles-history-list');
  if (!articlesHistoryList) return;

  function updateArticlesHistory() {
    let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('affinedrift_articles_history') || '[]');
    
    // Track individual article pages - get full pathname to properly detect articles/
    const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
    const currentUrl = currentPath.split('/').pop() || 'articles.html';
    const isArticlePage = currentPath.includes('/articles/') || currentUrl === 'articles.html';
    
    // List of article pages for validation
    const ARTICLE_PAGES = [
      'articles.html',
      'theory-part1.html',
      'theory-part2.html',
      'theory-part3.html',
      'theory-part4.html',
      'theory-part5.html',
      'inverse-dynamics.html',
      'wrist-universal-joint.html',
      'nonlinear-control-insights.html',
      'drift-components-wrench-double-pendulum.html',
      'secondary-axis-stability.html',
      'controllability-drift-ratio.html',
      'strokes-gained-limitations.html',
      'superposition.html',
      'screw-theory-reference.html',
      'null-space-constraint-jacobian.html',
      'lagrangian-reference.html',
      'inverse-dynamics-inference.html',
      'force-mobility-matrices.html',
      'affine-nature-golf-swing.html',
      'appendix-applications.html'
    ];
    
    if (isArticlePage || ARTICLE_PAGES.includes(currentUrl)) {
      const currentPage = {
        title: document.title.replace(' - AffineDrift', '').replace('AffineDrift - ', ''),
        url: currentPath.includes('/articles/') ? 'articles/' + currentUrl : currentUrl
      };

      history = history.filter(item => item.url !== currentPage.url);
      history.unshift(currentPage);
      history = history.slice(0, 10);
      localStorage.setItem('affinedrift_articles_history', JSON.stringify(history));
    }

    if (history.length === 0) {
      articlesHistoryList.innerHTML = '<li class="history-empty">No recent articles yet</li>';
      return;
    }

    articlesHistoryList.innerHTML = history.map(item => 
      `<li><a href="${item.url}">${item.title}</a></li>`
    ).join('');
  }

  updateArticlesHistory();
});
</script>
